G_S: L_stale - L_fresh, as letter Sec II/V7-3 and brief section 6; section 8 fresh-minus-stale is inconsistent
authority: approved design implementation; AI work is not author self-writing or mentor review
commit_policy: no commit in this task; lock is a content hash, not a claim of committed preregistration
exposure: old V7-3/V7-4 data and decision results known; new ODs do not make underlying days unseen
test input matrices/strata and decision states may be read by step0; no future evaluation
pilot outcomes use a separate seed and are exposure before truth
pilot: one full N32/K64/Rdec64/Reval128 record; max input-only active-link/OD step-work proxy over test-S, earliest regime/date tie; seed pilot; selection before outcomes

prediction.null: sign((train-S mean max-util Switch minus Stay, equally weighted days/instances/unique sides) * deltaF); no queues
prediction.population: train-S only; deltaF=Switch stale share minus fresh share

screen.O_test: NOT_RUN before any decisions or evaluation
screen.X2: test-S: pool 3 regimes and both tau; one comparison per instance/tau, no horizon duplication; any TH >= 1% disagreement
screen.X4: test-S: pool 3 regimes and unique fresh/stale300/stale900 sides for each h; Hybrid/Stationary >=1% at h=1h or 2h
screen.independence: counts are denominators sharing days/instances, not independent trials
screen.train: identical tables on all train days and separately train-S; training gates descriptive only

seeds.collision_note: 7412001/7472001 were used by V7-4; explicit brief bases retained, actual streams are domain separated

selection.X2: exclude DAY1/2/3 ODs; Stay crosses global busiest link, Yen-2 Switch avoids it; descending train mean OD, then OD id
selection.X4: exclude old and selected X2 ODs; Switch path max train mean utilization >= .75 * Stay path max; prefer distinct bottlenecks, then descending min(two path maxima), descending mean OD, OD id
selection.utilization: total load with managed OD exactly once on the action-specific path; 26 train weekday/window average

slope_training: N32 independent initial states on each of 26 train weekdays; 6h action-paired rate rollout, pooled per-day mean Switch-minus-Stay, including S and O; not test outcomes

utilization.fresh: decision slot TM (first window slot) times observed OD modes; full routed load, no queues
utilization.long_age: CTMC expected modes decay exp(-2*tau); analytic expectation equals slot mean at infinite age, empirical K still has sampling noise
utilization.stale: same decision slot TM times empirical endpoint-mode expectation from the same K Stay posterior samples as M0
utilization.theta_ge_1: no Switch when max-util Stay<=1; no universal guarantee with instantaneous overload, per literal section 4 formula
utilization.tie: MLU: equal path maxima; TH: exact Stay-threshold equality or equal path maxima while threshold active; report both boundaries too
